reuse.why: Changes the rule only inside the existing shared getRangedAmount and getWorstCaseAmount, which every schedule amount path (preview, posting, actions sync, forecast, templates, API) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the two shared helpers; the other files only get comment updates.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines the expected-amount rule.

scope.why: Two one-line rule changes, matching comment and test-name updates, and a release note.

maintainability.why: Central and simple; the helper is still named getWorstCaseAmount and callers keep their own number-vs-range dispatch, but the rule itself lives in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers already use getWorstCaseAmount/getRangedAmount; none is bypassed.
